plain: A man who was stationed with the US Air Force claims he saw a Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint, being unloaded from a C-130 military cargo plane in the Azores, the Portuguese islands in the Atlantic. The researcher known online as UAPGerb mentions this on the show, without naming the man, and says he plans to talk to him soon. If true, it would mean the military was moving one of these objects around as cargo.
